title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Smarter resolution for builtins and KMP
summary: v1.13.0 improves navigation accuracy for standard Kotlin and Java built-in types, and adds correct expect/actual resolution for Kotlin Multiplatform projects.

highlights.title: Implicit Default Import Resolution
highlights.description: Go to Definition now resolves standard Kotlin and Java types (String, List, Int, Thread, etc.) that are available without explicit imports — navigation no longer fails on unimported built-ins.

highlights.title: Kotlin Multiplatform expect/actual Support
highlights.description: The resolver recognizes expect and actual modifiers and prefers the actual implementation on FQN lookup, so navigation in KMP projects lands on the concrete implementation rather than the abstract declaration.

sections.heading: Improvements
bullets: Added implicit default import awareness for Kotlin (kotlin.*, kotlin.collections.*, kotlin.io.*, and related packages) and Java (java.lang.*) — Go to Definition now works on built-in types that appear without an import statement.
Added expect/actual modifier support for Kotlin Multiplatform projects; FQN lookups now prefer the actual declaration, giving more precise jump targets in multi-platform codebases.
